transform: Reuse atlas RDP at 0.018 degrees with tiny/dateline rings preserved; five-decimal coordinates. Source validity filtering; non-aggregate polity records; reviewed existence-window exclusions; no invented country geometry. CShapes dates apply only to its coded state/dependency validity, not to actual wartime occupation. Annual Cliopatria layers are not January-1 frontiers.
limitations: Era choices are editorial turning points, not an objective ranking of history.
Ancient and medieval coverage is incomplete and contains remaining source uncertainty, overlaps and source aggregates.
All economic, population and technology templates are synthetic gameplay values; no era-specific warfare, religion or institutions are simulated.
1783 and 2026 continue to use the preserved atlas layers and documented limitations.
